description: This file contains the implementation of NVMe controller initialization, configuration, and management functions for Zephyr OS, including PCIe setup, queue management, and controller identification.

methods.name: nvme_controller_wait_for_ready
methods.description: Waits for the NVMe controller to reach the desired ready state within a timeout.

methods.name: nvme_controller_disable
methods.description: Disables the NVMe controller, waiting for it to become not ready.

methods.name: nvme_controller_enable
methods.description: Enables the NVMe controller, initializing necessary registers and waiting for it to become ready.

methods.name: nvme_controller_setup_admin_queues
methods.description: Sets up the admin submission and completion queues for the NVMe controller.

methods.name: nvme_controller_setup_io_queues
methods.description: Configures IO submission and completion queues based on controller capabilities.

methods.name: nvme_controller_gather_info
methods.description: Reads and logs controller capabilities and configuration from MMIO registers.

methods.name: nvme_controller_pcie_configure
methods.description: Configures PCIe settings, including BAR mapping and MSI-X vector allocation.

methods.name: nvme_controller_identify
methods.description: Sends identify command to retrieve controller data and adjusts transfer size limits.

methods.name: nvme_controller_setup_namespaces
methods.description: Initializes namespaces based on controller data.

methods.name: nvme_controller_init
methods.description: Performs full initialization sequence for the NVMe controller device.
